item.title: LanFi 5.0.2
item.description:
## LanFi 5.0.2
### Fixed - **Local Network gating.** LanFi now requests macOS Local Network access in-process before scanning; reading the ARP table through the `arp` subprocess never triggered the permission prompt, so the app stayed unauthorized. The scanner reports when the ARP table is unavailable and shows an actionable gate (Open Settings, Request access, Rescan) instead of a passive note, and the shelf no longer ingests identity-free fallback rows.
### Docs - `docs/mcp.md` documents the Device Shelf tool in full: storage location, every argument, the row schema and a runnable example.
### Tooling - Removed a stale local `post-commit` hook that pointed at a deleted `scripts/autopush.sh` outside the repository.
### Install 1. Download `LanFi.dmg` (or `LanFi.zip`). 2. Drag LanFi to Applications. 3. Open LanFi and allow Location Services when prompted — macOS requires it to reveal SSIDs/BSSIDs. 4. If Gatekeeper blocks the ad-hoc signed build, right-click the app and choose Open.
The always-latest build lives at <https://github.com/zheltukheen/lanfi/releases/latest/download/LanFi.dmg> (`LanFi.zip` for the archive). The same unversioned names are used inside each tagged release.
### Verify The SHA-256 checksums are attached as `LanFi.sha256`.
